cluster_relationships: PAGA on the amp-batch-aware kNN graph yields three major axes from a shared myeloid progenitor pool: (1) a granulocytic axis Cd34+ CMP (cl10) / Plac8+ GMP (cl9) -> immature granulocyte (cl4) -> mature neutrophil (cl3), with a Cebpe-KO-enriched neutrophil-like branch (cl11); (2) an erythroid/megakaryocytic axis Gata2+ multipotent progenitor (cl2) -> early erythroid (cl1) -> mature (cl5) and ribosome-rich late (cl6), with the megakaryocyte cluster (cl0) branching off the early state; (3) a DC axis Cd34+ CMP (cl10) -> MHC-low precursor (cl7) -> MHCII+ DC (cl8). Cebpa-KO cells are predominantly in the erythroid clusters (erythroid skewing); Cebpe-KO cells concentrate in cl11 plus mature neutrophil cl3.
model: QC filtering (drop empty wells; total UMI >=500; genes in >=3 cells) -> library-size normalization to 1e4 + log1p -> 3000 Seurat-style HVGs (amp-batch-aware) -> PCA (30 dims) -> batch-aware kNN graph (global k=100, trimmed to <=13 neighbors per amplification batch, ~50 total, UMAP fuzzy-simplicial connectivities) -> UMAP -> Leiden (res 0.7) -> t-test marker ranking -> PAGA cluster relationship graph -> diffusion-pseudotime from the Cd34+ CMP root.
software_used: python 3.14, scanpy 1.12.1, anndata 0.12.16, pandas 2.3.3, numpy 2.1.3, scipy 1.14.1, scikit-learn 1.6.1, matplotlib 3.10.3, umap-learn 0.6.0, leidenalg 0.12.0, igraph 1.0.0, statsmodels 0.15.0 (all pre-installed; no packages installed)
